The richest people you will ever meet say seven words out loud, in private, in a very specific order.

Kevin Trudeau calls it a ladder of internal confidence. Climb it and your words stop working against you.

Most people never notice it, because the people who use it do not even realize they are doing it. You have to watch them for days to see the pattern.

If your income looks the same as it did five years ago, start by listening to how you talk.

Comment WISH and I'll send you the free audios that walk through all seven.

#kevintrudeau #millionairemindset #manifestation #yourwishisyourcommand #wealthhabits #selfimage

Everyone says the same thing when they hear a recording of themselves: that is not what I sound like.

Kevin Trudeau explains why. On a recording, all of the sound reaches your ear. When you speak, only about 20 percent does. The other 80 percent travels through bone and vibrates your brain directly.

Which means every word you say out loud is being fed straight into your own mind.

What have you been telling yourself lately?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #wordshavepower #selftalk #brain #successhabits

Saying I want to be a millionaire can backfire. If part of you does not believe it, the statement fights the picture you have of yourself, and nothing moves.

Kevin Trudeau starts one rung lower. Say it out loud: I wish I was a millionaire. Anyone can make a wish, so nothing inside you argues with it.

Repeat it for a day or two and the needle starts to move. Then you climb to the next word.

Comment WISH and I'll send you the free audios on the full ladder.

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #yourwishisyourcommand #affirmations #millionairemindset #lawofattraction

Most affirmation books tell you to start with I am a millionaire. Kevin Trudeau says that is the last step, not the first.

You only say I am when you know. Not believe, know. Like a runner with the ball and nobody between him and the goal line.

Before that, you climb: I wish, I want, I could, I can, I will, I am in the process. Each rung blows off the doubt the last one stirred up.

Say it at the end and it resonates 100 percent as true.
